description: An INSPECT CONVERTING whose TO operand is a figurative constant beginning with ALL — a COBOL-2002 relaxation of a COBOL-85 restriction, QUOTED from ISO/IEC 1989:2002 Annex F.2 item 75: "INSPECT CONVERTING statement. A figurative constant beginning with ALL may be specified as the TO literal in the INSPECT CONVERTING statement." COBOL-85 is the edition a 2002 Annex F.2 'formerly' statement describes: the owner's decision of 2026-10-31 (kb/Work PB4305) makes the F.2 statements the rule for the 85 edge, as D-SIGN2 (item 124) and PB3683 (item 123) did; GnuCOBOL -std=cobol85 accepts some of them as dialect leniency, which rule 1 places below the ISO text. Gated in ONE place, VersionConformancePass.ParseArm.VisitInspectConvertingPhrase (kb/Work PB4305; VCR row 7.47).
display: an INSPECT CONVERTING whose TO operand is a figurative constant beginning with ALL
citation: ISO §2023:14.9.22.3 SR3; ISO/IEC 1989:2002 Annex F.2 item 75
